verdict.rationale: ReelMimic's own architecture runs entirely on the user's computer, so project data is stored wherever the user's machine is. That gives de facto control over storage location (reelmimic-docs-9). However, it relies on the user's Claude Code or Codex and optional cloud services like ElevenLabs (reelmimic-gh-7), and nothing documents where those providers process data or lets the user pick a region. Missing for 10: an explicit region/residency selection, documentation of data flows to the AI and TTS providers, and independent corroboration.
